lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team. The dataset contains approximately 3.6 million buildings with an average data age of 5 years and includes AI-based estimates of mapping completeness (51% of total buildings). Data are provided in multiple geospatial formats (SHP, KML, GeoJSON, Geopackage) for disaster risk exposure assessment.
